title: Down into Vicrium
journal: The knight-captain's disc bears the mark of Vicrium, a mine behind Seafalls, where the knights kept a strongbox. The lower galleries are shut behind a locked timber door; the gallery-boss, Ah-Zish, keeps the key, and an old adit on the creek bank goes round it through water where crocodiles nest. I'm to get into the lower galleries and find the knights' strongbox. Ah-Zish might give the key to good words or 100 gold, or it can be lifted from him. Smugglers have moved into the lower galleries; I may fight them or sneak past.
objectives: Get into Vicrium's lower galleries, by Ah-Zish's key or the old lower adit. (marker: Ah-Zish, Door to Lower Galleries, Old Lower Adit)
Search the knights' strongbox in the lower galleries. (marker: Knights' Strongbox)

plan.going: The disc points to Vicrium, where the knights kept a strongbox in galleries now shut.
plan.next: Go by boat to Seafalls and up the road to Vicrium; get into the lower galleries and find the strongbox.
plan.ways: Ah-Zish's key (persuade him, pay 100 gold or pick his pocket), or the flooded adit past the crocodiles. In the galleries, fight the smugglers or sneak past them.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. The knight-captain disc bears the Vicrium mark, an old ochre and alum mine behind Seafalls, where the knights kept a strongbox. I must find that strongbox.
Get into the lower galleries of Vicrium and search the knights strongbox there.

Get the key from Ah-Zish by good words or 100 gold, or lift it from him; or take the old lower adit on the creek bank through water where crocodiles nest; smugglers are in the lower galleries so I can fight or sneak.
I do not know what the Root and the Eye are, how Nesh-Deeka knows what she knows, or why the Unbound seal trees. I might learn by talking to people and finding the strongbox contents.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: In the knights' strongbox lay an old parchment map: seven towers standing in the sea, and a crag shaped like a tooth on an island. I'm to bring it to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
objectives: Bring the parchment map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I have a map of seven sea towers and a tooth-shaped crag.

answers: I work for Nesh-Deeka. I went round the locked door through the old adit, past the crocodiles, and found the knights strongbox in the lower galleries. It held an old parchment map showing seven towers standing in the sea and a tooth-shaped crag on an island.
Bring the map to Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
I can go straight back to Helstrom, or read the map first or look around the galleries. A smuggler is here. I could also go after the Unbound or the Collector Ennodius Vanin later.
I do not know where the seven towers or the tooth crag are, what the Root and the Eye are, or why the Unbound seal trees. Nesh-Deeka may know, and I could ask her.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: Nesh-Deeka already knew the Unbound had not reached Vicrium. Before I could ask how, she said "we listen" and named me Toh-Wo, "Secret-Speaker", the order's second rank, with 200 gold. I'm to choose the order's gift: a rapier or a quarterstaff.
objectives: Choose a rapier or a quarterstaff from Nesh-Deeka. (marker: Nesh-Deeka)

plan.going: I am a Toh-Wo now. Nesh-Deeka again knew where the Unbound had not been and would not say how.
terms: Toh-Wo: Nesh-Deeka: "Secret-Speaker", the order's second rank

answers: I gave Nesh-Deeka the map. She says it is another step towards the Eye of Argonia at the Root, and that her officer must read the towers and the crag. She knew the Unbound had not reached Vicrium and only said we listen. She named me Toh-Wo, Secret-Speaker, second rank, and paid 200 gold.
Choose the order gift, a rapier or a quarterstaff, from Nesh-Deeka in Helstrom.
Take the rapier or the quarterstaff. I could also ask her what we are hunting.
I still do not know what the Root and the Eye of Argonia really are, how she listens, or why the Unbound seal trees. I could ask her or follow the map.

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: I took the rapier. Nesh-Deeka passed me to her officer, Never-Writes-Twice, who stands at the back of the same room; from now on I report to her. I'm to show her the map.
objectives: Show the map to Never-Writes-Twice in Nesh-Deeka's House. (marker: Never-Writes-Twice)

title: Down into Vicrium
journal: Never-Writes-Twice knew the crag on the map: the Grey Tooth, the seamark of Skeith Isle. She told me Cuts-the-Old-Knot was once one of the order, who went mad on sap and killed her minders. She marked the Grey Tooth.

plan.going: The map leads to the Grey Tooth on Skeith Isle. Never-Writes-Twice says Cuts-the-Old-Knot was one of the order gone mad on sap.
plan.next: MN11 starts; its first entry marks the Grey Tooth.
terms: the Grey Tooth and Skeith Isle: Never-Writes-Twice: a crag that is the seamark of Skeith Isle

answers: The quest is done. The map shows the Grey Tooth, seamark of Skeith Isle, reached by boat to Archon and Arorha; Never-Writes-Twice marked it. She warned me about Cuts-the-Old-Knot, a former member who went mad on sap and killed her minders, and told me not to listen to her.
Nothing is set yet; likely Skeith Isle by boat via Archon and Arorha, or the Unbound and the Collector Ennodius Vanin.
Ask Never-Writes-Twice what we hunt, or go to Skeith Isle, or chase the Unbound or the Collector.
Unknown: the seven towers, what the Root and the Eye are, how the order listens, why the Unbound seal trees, and who Cuts-the-Old-Knot is and where.
